instagram_title: Sale91 DTF Pieces vs Sheets — This Confusion Changes Your Cost
youtube_description: On Sale91's DTF order form, 'pieces' doesn't mean the number of T-shirts. It means how many times your entire uploaded sheet gets printed, and the price is the sheet's real height times the pieces. If you upload a separate sheet for every design instead of ganging them together, you end up paying for more sheets. Sale91's DTF sheet is 22.8 inches wide and 39 to 390 inches tall (other printers use other widths), so one sheet can carry designs for many T-shirts. Put all your designs on one gang sheet to keep your DTF printing cost down. #dtfprinting #tshirtbusiness #printingbusiness #bulkprinting #wholesale #tshirtprinting #gangsheet #textileindustry
